expected_issues.title: `Default`, `Critical`, and `Separator` are nullable
expected_issues.description: `Default`, `Critical`, and `Separator` are nullable. If `Default` isn't set in XAML, this selector can return null templates (both on entry and in the fallback). Consider making `Default` non-null (required), or provide a safe non-null fallback (e.g., base.SelectTemplateCore / throw with a clear message) to avoid silent UI failures.
